title: Encrypted DNS Provisioning RFC 9464 Scalar Attribute Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, DNS package build, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9464 scalar provisioning attribute surface.
scope: This verification covers scalar reserved-bit policy, two-octet Length fields, zero-length ENCDNS_IP* CFG_REQUEST/CFG_ACK behavior, IPv4/IPv6 address-family validation, DNS presentation-form ADN validation, forbidden hint SvcParam rejection, service-parameter sharing, ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute type 29, hash-algorithm count and length formulas, zero ADN length for request hash lists, and no padding between hash identifiers.
preconditions: The RFC 9464 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9464.json`.
The RFC 9464 scalar provisioning behavior remains in `Incursa.Quic.Dns` rather than in the QUIC transport runtime.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9464 tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9464 artifacts, generated triage reflects the scalar slice, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The RFC 9464 encrypted DNS provisioning scalar attribute floor is trace-owned and verified. IKEv2 wire encoding/parsing, full RFC 9460 SvcParam encoding, certificate digest validation, and resolver provisioning remain future work.
